Location: Davis 118

Starts (original): 2019-02-06 5:30 pm

Join us for an evening of quiet writing, hacking on your own website, lesson plan development, wiki editing, IndieWeb demos and discussions!

All skill levels welcome. If you ever wanted your own website or have one already stop by.

You can also work with Dr. Mac on anything #literacies related.
